about:
# Live Editor Background
Normally, change BG, G, and MG triggers only show a preview in the editor **when playtesting**. <cb>This mod removes that restriction and lets you preview those triggers' behavior live</c> (music playback supported).

Additionally, this mod also <cg>fixes</c> the bug where the ground is <cr>zoomed incorrectly</c> when changed in the editor.
